about_the_game:
Writer Tycoon – Build Your Legacy, One Word at a Time!

Ever dreamed of becoming a bestselling author? Writer Tycoon puts you in the chair of an aspiring writer, starting from scratch and working your way up to literary fame. Write books, explore different genres, grow your fanbase, and manage your career to become a legend in the publishing world.

 WRITE, PUBLISH, AND DOMINATE THE INDUSTRY

  • Choose from a variety of genres – from Sci-Fi to Romance, Horror, and more.

  • Write multiple books at once and watch your sales evolve over time.

  • Experiment with trends to maximize book sales and avoid flops.

 MANAGE YOUR WRITING CAREER

  • Handle reviews that shape your reputation – will you be a critic’s darling or a controversial bestseller?

  • Earn fans and use your growing influence to boost future book launches.

 BUILD YOUR PUBLISHING EMPIRE

  • Start small, writing in your bedroom, and work your way up to owning your own publishing house.

  • Take on different jobs to keep your cash flow steady so that you can work on your masterpiece, or do a range of other activities to keep your creative juices flowing.

Can you become the next literary icon? Or will your career end before it even begins?

 KEY FEATURES

 Write, publish, and market books across multiple genres
 Dynamic sales system with real-time trends and fan reactions
 Realistic book review system that shapes your reputation
